name: EM FX Carry-to-Vol Ranking: BRL, MXN, ZAR, IDR (VIX Regime)
description: Ranks BRL, MXN, ZAR, and IDR by carry-to-volatility ratio (short-term interest rate differential vs US Fed Funds / 63-day realized FX vol). Adds VIX regime filter (low-vol: VIX < 20, high-vol: VIX >= 20) to show whether the carry-to-vol premium concentrates in calm or stressed markets. Outputs: carry-to-vol time series, current ranking, regime-split cumulative returns of top-ranked vs equal-weight, and summary table with stats by VIX regime.
source:
# EM FX Carry-to-Vol Ranking: BRL, MXN, ZAR, IDR
# With VIX regime filter (low-vol < 20, high-vol >= 20)
# Carry = EM short-term rate - US Fed Funds
# Vol = 63-day annualized realized FX vol
# Carry-to-vol ratio ranked cross-sectionally

# --- Data Sources ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# EM short-term interest rates (monthly, ffill to daily)
brl_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')()
mxn_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01MXM156N')()
zar_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01ZAM156N')()
idr_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01IDM156N')()

brl_rate = ffill(brl_rate_raw.result)
mxn_rate = ffill(mxn_rate_raw.result)
zar_rate = ffill(zar_rate_raw.result)
idr_rate = ffill(idr_rate_raw.result)

# US Fed Funds rate (daily)
us_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DFF')()
us_rate = ffill(us_rate_raw.result)

# VIX (daily, CBOE Volatility Index)
vix_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='VIXCLS')()
vix = ffill(vix_raw.result)

# --- VIX Regime ---
is_low_vol = is_valid(vix) and vix < 20.0
is_high_vol = is_valid(vix) and vix >= 20.0

# --- Asset Identification ---
is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker='^USDBRL')()
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker='^USDMXN')()
is_zar = is_asset_ref(ticker='^USDZAR')()
is_idr = is_asset_ref(ticker='^USDIDR')()

# --- Carry Calculation ---
# Route the correct EM rate to each asset context
em_rate = conditional_select(is_brl, brl_rate, is_mxn, mxn_rate, is_zar, zar_rate, is_idr, idr_rate, 0.0)

# Carry = EM rate - US rate (in percentage points per annum)
carry = em_rate - us_rate

# --- Volatility ---
# 63-day annualized realized vol
vol_63d = volatility(period=63)(close)

# --- Carry-to-Vol Ratio ---
# Carry is in % p.a., vol is annualized decimal (e.g., 0.15 = 15%)
# Convert vol to % for consistent units
carry_to_vol = where(is_valid(vol_63d) and vol_63d > 0, carry / (vol_63d * 100.0))

# --- Cross-Sectional Ranking ---
# Rank 1 = highest carry-to-vol (best risk-adjusted carry)
ctv_rank = cs_rank(ascending=False)(carry_to_vol)

# Top-ranked flag
is_top = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, k=1)(carry_to_vol)

# --- Returns ---
# Daily FX returns: USDXXX pairs, long EM = short USD = negative return on pair
usd_ret = returns(period=1)(close)
em_ret = -1.0 * usd_ret

# --- Cumulative Return by VIX Regime ---
# Lag top-rank by 1 day to avoid look-ahead
is_top_prev = is_top >> 1

# Top-ranked currency return
top_ret = where(is_valid(is_top_prev) and is_top_prev, em_ret)

# Equal-weight basket return
ew_weight = equal_weight()(is_valid(close))
ew_ret = em_ret * ew_weight

# Regime-filtered returns for top-ranked strategy
top_ret_low_vol = where(is_low_vol, top_ret)
top_ret_high_vol = where(is_high_vol, top_ret)

# Regime-filtered returns for equal-weight basket
ew_ret_low_vol = where(is_low_vol, ew_ret)
ew_ret_high_vol = where(is_high_vol, ew_ret)

# Cumulative returns by regime (sum of daily returns)
cum_top_low = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_valid(top_ret_low_vol), top_ret_low_vol))
cum_top_high = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_valid(top_ret_high_vol), top_ret_high_vol))
cum_ew_low = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_valid(ew_ret_low_vol), ew_ret_low_vol))
cum_ew_high = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_valid(ew_ret_high_vol), ew_ret_high_vol))

# Overall cumulative returns
cum_top_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_valid(top_ret), top_ret))
cum_ew_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(ew_ret)

# --- Forward returns for summary stats (21-day = ~1 month) ---
fwd_21d = forward_returns(period=21)(close)
em_fwd_21d = -1.0 * fwd_21d

# Stats inputs: top-ranked forward return by regime
top_fwd_21d = where(is_valid(is_top_prev) and is_top_prev, em_fwd_21d)
top_fwd_low = where(is_low_vol, top_fwd_21d)
top_fwd_high = where(is_high_vol, top_fwd_21d)

# Hit rate series: 1.0 if forward return positive, 0.0 if negative (for Mean agg = hit rate)
hit_rate_low = 1.0 if (is_valid(top_fwd_low) and top_fwd_low > 0) else 0.0 if is_valid(top_fwd_low) else top_fwd_low
hit_rate_high = 1.0 if (is_valid(top_fwd_high) and top_fwd_high > 0) else 0.0 if is_valid(top_fwd_high) else top_fwd_high

# --- Timestamps ---
ts = index()

# --- Output 1: Carry-to-Vol Ratio Over Time (CONTEXT) ---
cs_lines(
    title='Which EM Currency Has the Best Risk-Adjusted Carry?',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    y_axis_label='Carry / Vol Ratio',
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Orange, Color.Teal, Color.Purple],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=carry_to_vol)

# --- Output 2: Current Ranking Snapshot (PUNCHLINE) ---
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Current Carry-to-Vol Ranking',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    data_labels=True,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Blue, Color.Blue, Color.Blue],
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Descending,
    y_axis_label='Carry / Vol Ratio',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=carry_to_vol)

# --- Output 3: Regime-Split Cumulative Returns (KEY FINDING) ---
# Top-ranked carry-to-vol strategy: low-VIX vs high-VIX cumulative returns
# Aggregated across assets (Sum) since only 1 asset is top-ranked at a time
cs_lines(
    title='Where Does the Carry Premium Live? (Top-Ranked Strategy)',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Red, Color.Gray],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(cum_top_low, cum_top_high, cum_ew_ret))

# --- Output 4: Summary Table — Stats by VIX Regime ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Top Carry-to-Vol: 21-Day Forward Return by VIX Regime',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Obs (Days)', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (% Positive)', 'Best', 'Worst'],
        col_headers=['Low VIX (<20)', 'High VIX (>=20)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    order=4
)(top_fwd_low, top_fwd_high, top_fwd_low, top_fwd_high, hit_rate_low, hit_rate_high, top_fwd_low, top_fwd_high, top_fwd_low, top_fwd_high)

# --- Event Markers: Rank Changes ---
became_top = is_top and (not (is_top >> 1))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='New #1 Carry-to-Vol',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry-to-Vol', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry (%)', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Vol (%)', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(carry_to_vol, carry, vol_63d * 100.0, vix, became_top)
